instruction: Configure Courier New as the default index font in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Courier New as the default index font in LibreOffice Writer. The evaluator reads the registrymodifications.xcu file to verify the Index font name under DefaultFont settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts the default index font from LibreOffice config file (registrymodifications.xcu) using proper XML parsing and XPath queries
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter - uses expected.get('index_font') which is the right pattern for type='rule'
Data flow is semantically correct: getter returns font name string, metric compares string equality
Full instruction coverage: single requirement (configure Courier New as index font) is properly verified
Expected value is semantically correct and matches instruction requirement exactly
Proper edge case handling: both getter and metric handle None/missing values appropriately
State is accessible without postconfig: registrymodifications.xcu is automatically saved by LibreOffice when settings are changed
